subject: Sponsor lounge merch — partial damage on arrival, need expedited replen
messages:
From: Samira Patel <samira@brightprintco.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: None
Date: 2026-08-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Shipment delivery to Moscone sponsor lounge - packing note and photos

Hey Marcus —

Shipment 3821 arrived at Moscone loading dock this morning at ~07:45. Venue ops flagged some cartons with water stains. We opened the three affected cartons and took photos (attached). Looks like there is surface scuffing and about ~22 units with logo abrasion (mostly embroidered hats and a couple of enamel pins with chipped enamel).

I wanted to give you an immediate heads-up before venue starts moving items into storage. Per our SLA, we cover manufacturing defects but not third-party carrier damage; we will file a claim with ShipSecure on your behalf if you want us to push that route.

Next steps I suggest:
- Confirm whether you want damaged units replaced onsite or if we should reprint and expedite from our LA shop (2–3 business day rush).
- If you want us to file a carrier claim, please confirm and we’ll include packing list + photos + invoice.

Attaching: bp_invoice_3821.pdf, packing_photos_0802.zip

— Samira
Account Lead, BrightPrint Co.
T: +1 415-555-0198
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Samira Patel <samira@brightprintco.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-02T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Shipment delivery to Moscone sponsor lounge - packing note and photos

Samira — thanks for the quick update and the photos. Ugh, thatlooks rough. We have a sponsor lounge opening preview tonight at 18:00 and a VIP reception tomorrow morning. We need at least 150 undamaged hats and 200 pins on-site by tonight if at all possible.

Evelyn / Laura — can you confirm inventory counts from venue ops? Diego, can you check whether we have any local stock or a nearer vendor?

Samira: please file the claim with ShipSecure and also send an expedited quote for 200 hats + 300 pins for same-day local fulfillment (if you have a partner who can do rush silk/embroider in SF/SJ). If printing onsite is impossible, well arrange a courier from your LA shop to SF overnight.

If costs exceed $2,500 well need to route for emergency approval (I can sign within 30 minutes if needed).

Thanks — Marcus
Head of Field Marketing (Acting)
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Shipment delivery to Moscone sponsor lounge - packing note and photos

Marcus — venue ops (Ashley at VenueOps) just called; they logged 420 total units delivered. They moved unaffected cartons into the secure storage room. Their on-site estimate: 120 hats OK, ~30 pins damaged, rest look fine but several boxes got water exposure on the lower flaps. Ashley is running a pallet-level scan and will send an itemized pick list in ~45 minutes.

Diego — can you stand by to pick up any local emergency stock from our SF promo partner (we have a small buffer of hats ~80 units at their warehouse). If we go the courier route from BrightPrint’s LA shop, well also need a same-day customs/manifest for the courier so venue will accept it.

— Evelyn

Subject: RE: Shipment delivery to Moscone sponsor lounge - packing note and photos

Hi all — attached is the venues receiving receipt (venue_receipt_ashley.pdf) and the preliminary pick list. We will hold the damaged cartons in a quarantine area and wont move anything into the lounge until we receive disposition instructions from the shipper or sender.

For tonight’s preview, we can stage up to 120 undamaged hats and 150 pins from whats intact, plus the backup swag in our on-site overflow (small quantity). If you need more than that tonight, you must provide replacement stock or authorize us to accept an incoming courier delivery after 16:00 local.

Let me know and Ill coordinate door access and receiving docs.

— Ashley
Operations Lead, VenueOps
From: Samira Patel <samira@brightprintco.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: Claims Team <claims@shipsecure.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-03T08:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Shipment delivery to Moscone sponsor lounge - packing note and photos

Marcus / team — we filed a priority claim with ShipSecure (Claim ID: SS-774201). ShipSecure asked for the invoice, packing list, photos, and venue receipt: attached. Theyre assigning an adjuster who indicated theyll adjudicate within 72 hours but wont cover AMS/overnight courier costs unless negligence is proved.

Attached also is a same-day fulfillment quote from our SF partner who can do embroidery + pin fulfillment and ship via local courier for delivery by 18:00 today. Cost: $2,950 for 200 hats (embroidered, rush) + 300 pins (rush press) including courier. If you want us to greenlight, well require written authorization and a PO.

Let me know now so we can commit their production slot.

— Samira
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Samira Patel <samira@brightprintco.com>, Ashley Rowe <ashley@venueops.io>

Samira — authorize the SF partner rush fulfillment. Approve up to $3,200 to include any incidental courier fees. Please issue a PO now referencing deal DEAL-8342 and start production. ShipSecure claim can run in parallel; we accept that claim proceeds may not cover rush cost.

Ashley — Diego will coordinate courier arrival and receiving paperwork with you. Evelyn / Laura — please update guest-facing inventory counts; Ill notify sponsorship lead for the lounge.

Samira — please send a short confirmation email with the PO number and expected ETA. Well mark this as an emergency spend on the event P&L and reconcile with claims later.
